content.text:
**BIS Hanoi (British International School Hanoi) students consistently score well above global and UK averages in both the IB Diploma Programme (IBDP) and Cambridge IGCSE.**

### IB Diploma results (Class of 2026)
According to the school’s official results:
- Average score: **35.11** (global average **30.88**)
- Ninth consecutive year above the worldwide average
- Two students (Gia Khanh / Phạm Bùi Gia Khanh and Seojung / Ryu Seojung) scored the maximum **45/45** (achieved by fewer than 1% of IB students worldwide)
- About **1 in 7** students scored **40+**
- **62.9%** awarded the IB Bilingual Diploma
- Highest-ever average Core Points (from Theory of Knowledge and the Extended Essay): **1.92** (out of 3)
- Pass rate: **96.8%** (global average **82.6%**), based on the school’s university profile (68 IB-related candidates, including some on the BIS Diploma pathway)

Recent prior years (school-reported averages):
- **2025**: 33.24 (global ~30.58); 9.7% scored 40+; top score 44; ~63% Bilingual Diploma; eighth year above the global average
- **2024**: 34.7 (global 30.3); 98% pass rate (global ~80%); average subject grade 5.51 (global 4.85); ~1 in 7 scored 40+; top score 44; 65.3% Bilingual Diploma
- **2023**: 35 (global ~30.24); 100% pass rate; one perfect 45; about 1 in 5 scored 40+

Graduates receive offers from universities such as Yale, Cambridge, UCL, UC Berkeley, LSE, King’s College London, Toronto, Melbourne, KAIST, and others.

### IGCSE results
**2026** (school figures, outperforming UK averages):
- **43%** of grades A or A* (UK average 23.1%)
- **89%** of grades A*–C (UK average 55.5%)
- **80.4%** of students achieved at least one A* or A
- Six students achieved a full set of A* and A grades

**2025**:
- **46%** of grades A* or A (England ~23%)
- **85%** A–C (England ~55%)
- Six students with a perfect set of A* and A grades
- Two students (Dakyung and Ayoung) later received Cambridge “Top in the World” awards in IGCSE Mathematics

**2024**:
- **45%** of grades A*–A and **86%** A*–C
- 10 students with a full set of A* and A grades (largest cohort at the time)

Sources include the school’s academic results page, official news releases on the Nord Anglia / BIS Hanoi site, and its university profile. Figures can be refined slightly between initial and final confirmed results; the numbers above follow the school’s published final figures where available.
